name: obsidian-web-cf
description: Cloudflare Workers deployment for obsidian-web (demo + personal use)

scripts.predeploy: npm run build && bash scripts/guard-deploy-target.sh main
scripts.predeploy:demo: npm run build:demo && bash scripts/guard-deploy-target.sh demo
scripts.predeploy:gdd: npm run build:gdd && bash scripts/guard-deploy-target.sh gdd
scripts.dev: bash scripts/build-assets.sh && npx wrangler pages dev ../../../.tmp/deployments/cloudflare/public
